limitations_json: ["dry-run validates table resolution, column presence, static dtypes, and options only","dry-run does not scan edge data, construct a graph, or prove source-vertex existence","source_vertices and the sources relation are multi-source BFS, not one BFS per source","source_vertices and the sources relation must contain at most one source per connected component","vertices output does not expose origin source per vertex","sources have distance 0 and null predecessor; unreached graph vertices remain in vertices output with null distance and predecessor","reachable describes arrival within the predicates and depth limit; vertices beyond that limit and disconnected vertices both return false","string logical vertex-domain BFS rejects edges.edge_id and edge-id predicate relations","target_vertices is required for path output and rejected for vertices output; join target relations to vertices output for multiple target distances","path output requires exactly one target row at execution time","vertices output searches until the depth limit or frontier exhaustion; path output stops after completing the target's BFS depth","options_schema_json is typed registry metadata; validate_call remains the authoritative call-specific checker","distances and reachability repeat between runs; when a vertex has several shortest-path parents, the returned predecessor can differ"]
